description:
modules/traegerview — GET /traeger/schools/occupancy (#4676): the Träger
row, the school IDs of the Träger, the school rows, the roster of the
Stichtagszahl rule, the group of each membership, the group names, the
booked care offerings and the child of each approved enrollment for the
whole school set in one administrative transaction. Flat in the number of
schools.
